title: Does Peacock Premium Have Ads in 2026?
summary: Learn why Peacock Premium includes ads in 2026, compare tiers, and explore the benefits of ad-supported streaming for viewers and brands.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


What consumers and marketers should know about Peacock ads.


1. 1


Peacock Premium includes ads despite its premium-sounding plan name.


2. 2


Premium Plus removes most ads, but important exceptions remain.


3. 3


Ad-supported tiers trade lower prices for recurring commercial interruptions.


4. 4


Peacock benefits from both subscription fees and advertising revenue.


5. 5


Advertisers gain targeted access, measurable performance, and premium audiences.
